page_title: FIO 3-2 ATA | Fiorentina v Atalanta 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+6' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+5' The ball goes behind for a corner. Atalanta will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

90+3' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) picks the ball up and blasts it from long range without any hesitation. His shot is directed towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reads it well and makes a fine save.
90+1' Fiorentina take a short corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. Alfred Duncan leaves the pitch and is replaced by Antonin Barak (Fiorentina).
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Luca Pairetto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' Luca Pairetto blows for a foul after Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
85' Ederson (Atalanta) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
84' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
81' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
80' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Matteo Ruggeri is replaced by Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta).
78' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) trips an opposition player and Luca Pairetto signals a foul.
76' 3 - 2 Goal! Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 3:2.
74' The game has come to an end for Teun Koopmeiners. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Michel Adopo (Atalanta).
74' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) replacing Dodo.
74' Here comes a substitution. Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for M'Bala Nzola.
73' Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Marco Carnesecchi stops the ball from going inside right post.
71' A lofted cross from Dodo (Fiorentina) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
68' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
68' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
65' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Nadir Zortea (Atalanta) for his blatant foul.
63' Here is a change. Nicolas Gonzalez is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Christian Kouame (Fiorentina).
63' Substitution. Rolando Mandragora is replaced by Arthur Melo (Fiorentina).
60' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nadir Zortea (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch so that Davide Zappacosta can be given a rest.
59' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Charles De Ketelaere and he is replaced by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta).
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ademola Lookman walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
56' Neat passing move from Atalanta in order to create new attacking opportunities.
53' 2 - 2 Goal - 2:2! Marten de Roon tees up Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Pietro Terracciano.
51' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
50' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
49' That was close by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
48' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
47' Ederson (Atalanta) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
46' Ederson (Atalanta) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45+3' Rough tackle by Ederson (Atalanta). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) bravely launches himself at a cross from Alfred Duncan and gives Marco Carnesecchi no chance with a close-range bullet header into the left of the goal. 2:1.
44' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
44' Referee Luca Pairetto sees the trip by Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
42' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
40' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
39' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina), whose effort would probably have ended in the roof of the net.
38' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
37' The ball is out of play and Fiorentina manage to earn a corner.
35' 1 - 1 Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) receives a great pass from his teammate and strikes a very powerful shot towards goal that goes inside of the right post!
34' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) has tested the patience of referee Luca Pairetto and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
33' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
32' M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
30' Dodo (Fiorentina) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
29' Atalanta get a corner.
28' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
28' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
24' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
24' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.

20' 0 - 1 Goal! Marten de Roon passes the ball to Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Pietro Terracciano couldn't do anything about it. 0:1.
19' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
18' A long ball forward to Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is intercepted.
17' Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Carnesecchi intercepts the ball.
16' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle and signals a foul after Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) brought his opponent down.
14' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
12' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is about to take a corner kick.
12' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the roof of the net, but Pietro Terracciano gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
11' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
9' Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
8' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle after Dodo (Fiorentina) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
5' The Atalanta players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Luca Pairetto is the one to supervise the game today.
